text: section talk one two routes splicelogic: one two groups transcripts come differential transcript usage (DTU) analysis. DTU methods test whether relative proportions transcripts within gene differ experimental conditions. upstream DTU method produces transcript-resolved differential usage statistics can used splicelogic, provided results include: per-transcript directional effect estimate (e.g. model coefficient, change isoform fraction, deltaPSI, etc.), adjusted p-value (equivalent significance metric thresholding). Common upstream DTU methods include: satuRn — fits quasi-binomial generalized linear models transcript usage proportions performs scalable transcript-level DTU testing. Particularly well suited larger datasets. Gene-level testing recommended via stageR. DRIMSeq — models transcript proportions within genes using Dirichlet-Multinomial framework, gene-level transcript-level testing. BANDITS — Bayesian hierarchical DTU method models transcript usage using Dirichlet-Multinomial explicitly accounts mapping uncertainty using equivalence classes, gene-level transcript-level testing. DEXSeq — primarily differential exon usage (DEU) method based negative binomial GLMs, commonly used transcript-level DTU workflows (e.g. rnaseqDTU Bioconductor 2018 workflow). log2 fold change coefficients DEXSeq can used directly splicelogic. limma edgeR (diffSplice / diffSpliceDGE) — can used DTU analyses (well exon-level), gene-level transcript-level testing. Regardless method used, per-transcript DTU statistics (effect estimates adjusted p-values) mapped onto individual exons transcript produce exon-level GRanges (see Exon ranges input splicelogic). annotated GRanges starting point splicelogic, beginning preprocess() followed event-specific functions (find_se(), find_ie(), etc., see find_*() functions).

title: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
text: splicelogic turns sets transcripts discrete splicing events. Unlike event-based tools work junction level, splicelogic operates whole transcript structures: within gene compares two groups transcripts exons, events derived full isoform context. detects skipped exons, included exons, mutually exclusive exons, retained introns, alternative 5’ 3’ splice sites, alternative transcription start end sites. splicelogic allows two groups transcripts compared defined upstream one two ways. can come explicit partition transcripts two sets, e.g. set novel transcripts set annotated reference transcripts, transcripts found disease samples relative found control samples. can come differential transcript usage (DTU) analysis, gives transcript effect estimate whose sign defines comparison. takes transcript-level results tables input, splicelogic compatible upstream DTU method (including DRIMSeq, DEXSeq, satuRn, edgeR), supporting flexible experimental designs. splicelogic operates exon-level data stored GRanges objects within R/Bioconductor. Given set exons carrying gene ID, transcript ID exon rank, splicelogic can used identify variety splicing events. See vignette details. splicelogic works well within tidyomics framework. Event results including exons introns underlying event can manipulated downstream using plyranges.
